realm.name: data_engineer
realm.description: Full access to the PoC catalog

realm.name: analyst
realm.description: Read access to the shared namespace only

realm.name: metadata_reader
realm.description: Read every catalog's metadata; read no data.

clients.name: PySpark CLI (public)
clients.description: Public client used by demo.py. Device flow for humans, password grant for tests.

clients.name: Spark Connect server (confidential)
clients.description: Requester for RFC 8693 standard token exchange. Must be confidential.

clients.name: Apache Polaris (token audience target)
clients.description: Exists so audience=polaris resolves; Polaris validates bearer tokens, it does not log in.

clients.name: Apache Polaris Console (public SPA)
clients.description: Browser app; authorization code + PKCE. Logs in as alice or bob so the console shows that user's view of the catalog.

clients.name: Polaris AuthZEN PDP
clients.description: Keycloak acts as the Policy Decision Point for Polaris. Polaris calls its AuthZEN endpoints as this client; the resources, scopes and permissions below ARE the policy.

clients.name: OpenMetadata ingestion
clients.description: Crawls the Polaris Iceberg catalog. Client credentials only: there is no human behind it and no browser flow to protect.
